mode_note.reason: codex has no equivalent for 'auto'. Its approval policies are untrusted/on-failure/on-request/granular/never, and every one except `never` waits for an answer on a channel a chat pane does not have -- a `codex exec` run has nobody to approve anything, so it would stall rather than prompt. This turn runs read-only instead of running something wider than you asked for.
